items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: spec-reviewer round-4 PASS confirms all 8 ACs met, citing exact file:line for each; no extra scope added beyond the mini-plan.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every subprocess.run call has TimeoutExpired/OSError handlers; read_text wrapped in try/except OSError; gpt_leg_provider/codex_settings now guard non-str/non-mapping config values (found by external review, fixed) rather than raising.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No hardcoded secrets; identity-locked model bindings via resolve_reviewer_model; cwd-hijack guard on binary resolution. The Codex sandbox's write-only (not read/network) restriction is documented as an accepted, stated risk rather than silently claimed as full isolation — Shipwright does not control codex CLI internals beyond its own flags, and the content sent is the same content already trusted to OpenRouter/OpenAI in the sibling legs.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 210 tests across the touched suites assert on outcomes (route selection, leg status, error reasons), not internals; happy-path and error-path (timeout, nonzero exit, TOCTOU, malformed config, symlink loop, cwd-hijack) both covered per new behavior.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No DB/pagination surface. One accepted trade-off: _codex_route_reachable can spawn a bounded (15s) subprocess per status-check call when codex is configured with no API keys — a narrow, non-default path; caching was considered and deliberately not added to avoid staleness risk for a low-severity, low-frequency cost.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All touched files at or under their bloat-baseline ceiling / the 300-line guideline; new test file split out (test_external_review_codex_availability.py) rather than exceeding the guideline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: shipwright_iterate_config.json's gpt_leg.provider field: producer (config_writer / hand-written project config) -> file -> consumer (load_review_config/gpt_leg_provider) round-trip covered by test_load_review_config_round_trip_per_project_overrides plus the CLI-level test that writes the real file and drives the real loader end to end.
